about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint John, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, we humbly implore You, our God, that we may also be protected by the prayers of the one in whose memory we have received these gifts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who is God and lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit forever and ever.

a.g: we may also be protected by the prayers of the one in whose commemoration we have received these gifts
